images.title: § 163(j) is back on *EBITDA*.
images.sub: Same company, same debt: *+$1,000,000* more interest deduction. Here’s the math.

images.title: What changed
images.text: The business interest limit is 30% of adjusted taxable income (ATI). The One Big Beautiful Bill Act (signed July 4, 2025) adds depreciation & amortization back to ATI again.
points: Tax years beginning after Dec 31, 2024: ATI ≈ *EBITDA*
images.note: Simplified. Ignores business interest income, floor plan interest and the small business exemption.

images.title: What it’s worth
images.box: Mostly timing: interest disallowed under the old rule carries forward. But a deduction now beats one later.

images.title: What to check in your *2025 numbers*
points: ATI recomputed with D&A added back?
Disallowed interest carried forward from 2022–2024 – used?
Deferred tax asset for that carryforward updated?
Small business exemption – does it apply to you?
Your states – do they follow the new rule?
